messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-1 alert for halcyon-prod (private VPC) — NLB target group health failing, 503s observed from customer traffic. Paging oncall.
oncall-sre: Ack. I'm on it. Root ts 1712469999. Triage steps runbook link: https://redwood/runbooks/vpc-nlb-health
maria-chen: Observed spike at 10:03 UTC — ~70% 503 across all zones to halcyon-dedicated-pool. NLB metrics show target unhealthy (failed health checks). No config deploys in last hour from customer side.
raj-patel: Checking security groups and target health. Can anyone confirm if we recently rotated NLB CIDR or moved TG to IP targets?
sylvia-netops: Noted: recent infra churn — auto-scaler moved targets to new EC2 set in private subnet with a stricter SG pinned. Healthchecks coming from NLB IPs are being rejected.
oncall-sre: Ok that's the likely cause. Quick mitigation: add temporary SG rule to allow NLB healthcheck range + open app health port from NLB. Which CIDR do we need?
raj-patel: NLB is internal — source IPs are instance-sourced, but target group health checks use the NLB's nodes. Easiest immediate fix: allow inbound from the NLB subnet (10.32.8.0/24) to port 8080 on halcyon targets.
sylvia-netops: I'll patch SG now. Command:
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d --protocol tcp --port 8080 --cidr 10.32.8.0/24 --region us-west-2
```
apply: sg-0a1b2c3d updated. Waiting for SG propagation.
maria-chen: Healthchecks started to succeed on two zones within 30s. Error rate trending down from 70% -> 12%.
customer-success: Customer (Halcyon) reporting intermittent 503s on their UI, they've been notified we are working and will provide status updates. They asked for ETA for full restoration.
oncall-sre: ETA ~10-15m to confirm stability across all AZs. Also enabling failover policy for halcyon route to dedicated fallback in case of reoccurrence. Doing safe roll: update route weights in console.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout step executed: route-weight halcyon-prod  -> fallback-hosted increased to 20% at 1712470120
maria-chen: Confirming: all targets healthy in TG, backend latency normal. Error rate now <1% for last 2 minutes.
ops-manager: Good work. Action items: 1) keep SG change until we complete postmortem 2) run audit to see why ASG launched instances with tighter SG 3) add test in deployment pipeline to validate SG/target compatibility
raj-patel: I'll open an infra PR to adjust ASG launch config to include NLB-subnet allow rule. Will include test in CI.
sylvia-netops: Reverting temporary open rule? Recommend leaving for 1h then revert after validation + capacity soak.
oncall-sre: I'll hand off to night oncall in 15m. Current status: mitigated, customer fallback active, monitoring for 20m. cc @customer-success to update Halcyon.
customer-success: Noted, will send update: "Service returned to normal; we routed a small portion of traffic to fallback during mitigation; engineering continuing validation." 
incident-bot: Paging note: incident marked mitigated at 1712470348, severity downgraded to P1 watch.
oncall-sre: Handoff to @raj-patel for follow-up. Leaving runbook notes and commands executed in the incident ticket."
